knowledge_abstraction.bug_theme: Empty tensor container dispatch fallback missing
knowledge_abstraction.general_principle: Functions accepting tensor containers may rely on tensor arguments for dispatcher-based dtype, device, and backend inference; empty containers can bypass such inference and expose missing fallback paths.

risk_dimensions.shape: Zero-length tensor list or degenerate/empty tensor elements inside the container
risk_dimensions.dtype: Missing dtype inference when no tensor argument is available
risk_dimensions.memory: Empty container with no tensor storage to provide layout or alignment hints
risk_dimensions.device: Missing device/backend inference when no tensor argument is available
risk_dimensions.execution_state: Dispatcher kernel selection before any tensor argument can be inspected

failure_mechanism.description: The public API accepts an empty TensorList, but the underlying dispatcher/schema requires tensor arguments to select a backend kernel and no fallback is registered, causing failure before or during kernel selection.

input_exploration: Vary tensor container length from zero to many
Include empty, non-empty, and mixed tensor elements
Vary shape, dtype, device, and memory layout of contained tensors
constraint_awareness: Empty tensor containers may leave dtype, device, and backend underdetermined
Some APIs expect explicit validation or fallback for zero tensor arguments
Container-level dispatch can fail before individual tensor validation
oracle_strategy: Treat unexpected NotImplementedError or dispatcher fallback errors as failures
Distinguish clear validation errors from backend dispatch failures
Compare non-empty input behavior with empty input to detect contract gaps

transferability.reason: The principle applies to any API accepting TensorList or variadic tensor inputs where dispatch inference depends on at least one tensor argument; empty containers may expose missing fallback paths across PyTorch and similar frameworks.

important_considerations: Explore zero-length tensor containers and empty tensor elements
Consider whether dtype, device, and backend can be inferred without tensor arguments
Check API contracts for explicit error handling versus missing fallback
generation_strategy: Generate harnesses that systematically vary container length and contained tensor properties across APIs accepting tensor lists, and validate that empty or degenerate inputs produce either documented validation errors or correct behavior rather than internal dispatch failures.
